audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Aurora Level 1 at 8/10 and the two-item stage at 8/10, both contradicted by the page's own text, and marked Levels 4-5 'Skill' while its why says Aurora controls trades and zoning. The full layer also called the lane HARD at 7.5/10 on a 52.04% win rate over 98 games.
audit.why: Level 1 Yorick has ghouls and no reach and Aurora has one spell — the existing whys[0] already says neither side wins it. Levels 4-5 are Aurora's: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1 and Mourning Mist 12s, so there are real gaps to trade in while he is still banking graves. At two items Eulogy of the Isles plus the swarm plus the wall win the side lane, which the existing whys[6] already says.
audit.corrected: Chart set as one atomic group to Skill / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Skill / Yorick with ratings 5/7/7/7/7/5/3, and difficulty re-rated EVEN 5.5/10 to match the win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike carried a cooldown or a real Yorick ability name; the packet flags this matchup as naming none of Yorick's five abilities and having zero cooldown-sequencing cues.
audit.why: The real spike shape is Last Rites (Q) at 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s giving him a healing auto-reset from level 1, Dark Procession (W) at 20/18/16/14/12s, Mourning Mist (E) at 12/11/10/9/8s, and Eulogy of the Isles (R) at 160/130/100s once four graves are banked. Aurora's counter-spikes are Twofold Hex's 900 range and Between Worlds at 140s.
audit.corrected: Every stage and spike now names the ability and its cooldown; the 20s/12s gap is written as the trading window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer consistently attributes the mist WALL to Yorick's E. It is his W. 'his E mist walls' appears in early, mid, whys[2], whys[4], spikes[1].text, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0].
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: Dark Procession (W) is the destructible wall that blocks enemy movement, 600 range, 20/18/16/14/12s. Mourning Mist (E) is a thrown globule that shreds armour, damages, slows and MARKS — and Yorick's summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets. The full layer already used Dark Procession correctly, so the two layers contradicted each other. Missing entirely was the actual decisive interaction: the E mark, not the wall, is what makes the ghoul swarm lethal, so leaving the mark's range matters more than leaving the ghouls.
audit.corrected: Every wall reference reassigned to Dark Procession (W) and every mark/slow reference to Mourning Mist (E); the mark-speeds-ghouls interaction is now stated in dosFull[1] and wants.foe[0].

audit.why: Kit file supplies all per-rank cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession 20s, Mourning Mist 12s, Last Rites 6s written in; the 20s no-cage window is named as the punish.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was listed in itemization but never justified anywhere the player would read it during a trade.
audit.why: Last Rites (Q) heals Yorick on a 6s cooldown at rank 1 and is an auto-attack reset, so extended trades refund him continuously; champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json flags this matchup for both needs-antiheal and the auto-reset burst tell.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal now tied to Last Rites by name and cooldown in spikes[0].text, tradeBad and dontsFull[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'Between the Worlds' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late.

edits.before: "Yorick at levels 1-2 is a melee with a couple of ghouls and no gap-closer, so start the poke war the instant you have Q. Curse him with Twofold Hex, recast to pull the curse back for the second hit, and weave E spirit blasts to chip him while your passive heals you off the spirits you exorcise. The thing to respect is his E — those mist walls slow you and box you in so his ghouls and autos free-hit you, so don't walk into them, and never let him bank four graves uncontested toward Maiden."
edits.after: "Yorick at levels 1-2 is a melee with a couple of ghouls and no gap-closer, so start the poke war the instant you have Q. Curse him with Twofold Hex, recast to pull the curse back for the second hit, and weave E spirit blasts to chip him while your passive heals you off the spirits you exorcise. Respect two spells: Dark Procession (W, 20s) is the destructible cage that boxes you in, and Mourning Mist (E, 12s, 700 range) shreds armour, slows and marks you so his ghouls sprint at you."

edits.before: "Levels 4-6 are your window — your Q cooldown and passive healing line up so you out-trade a Yorick who can't chase your W leap. At 6, Between Worlds answers his whole kit: you go untargetable and walk straight through his E mist walls instead of being slowed and chewed up by ghouls inside them, and a W reset off a takedown snowballs you ahead of his graves. Bait the E, leap out with W when ghouls swarm, and try to burst him down before Maiden is ever a factor."
edits.after: "Levels 4-6 are your window — your Q cooldown and passive healing line up so you out-trade a Yorick who can't chase your W leap. At 6, Between Worlds answers his cage: the rift crosses Dark Procession's wall instead of you being slowed by Mourning Mist and chewed up by ghouls inside it, and a W reset off a takedown snowballs you ahead of his graves. Bait Mourning Mist, leap out with W when ghouls swarm, and try to burst him down before Maiden is ever a factor."

notes: Two claims in the existing text I left untouched because Riot's data cannot confirm them: (a) Between Worlds granting untargetability — the description lists damage, a slow and a traversable zone only, so my replacement text says the rift 'crosses' his wall rather than asserting untargetability; the original untargetability wording survives in late and wants.you where I did not edit; (b) 'a W reset off a takedown' in mid — Across the Veil's description contains no takedown reset. Kit-flag misfire: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json tags Mourning Mist (E) with 'dash', but Riot's description for it says only that he throws a globule and that his summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets — no Yorick dash. The existing text says Yorick has no gap-closer, which I neither strengthened nor reversed. Also: full layer said diff HARD while report[14] said 'Tricky matchup' and the win rate is 52.04% for Aurora — I set both to EVEN 5.5/10.
